user.title: Enea Energy
user.description: You need two UUIDs: `pointOfDeliveryId` from the POST body of `summaryBalancingChart`; if your account has multiple contracts, also `current_client_id` from `…/dashboard/select-current-client/<UUID>` after selecting the right contract. Hourly data is stored as external recorder statistics — use a Lovelace Statistics card with the statistic ID (integration log / Developer Tools → Statistics).

data.current_client_id: Optional: client ID from select-current-client/… URL (multiple contracts)

reconfigure.title: Enea Energy
reconfigure.description: Update settings. Leave password empty to keep the current one.

error.invalid_point_of_delivery: Enter the point of delivery ID (UUID from DevTools → Network).

abort.reconfigure_successful: Settings saved. The integration was reloaded.
